purpose: Verified contract for assembling a citizen-facing property legal-life answer from approved components.
source_rule: Only approved verified facts, legal analysis, procedures, citations and limitations may enter a definitive answer.
scope_rule: Assembly follows the approved answer plan and does not silently broaden scope.
traceability_rule: Every material answer component retains a trace to evidence or legal authority.
temporal_rule: Historical answers preserve historical dates and applicable legal versions.
limitation_rule: Material evidence or legal limitations remain visible.
privacy_rule: Restricted evidence and unnecessary personal information are excluded.
verification_boundary: Assembly is a presentation layer; it does not create new legal conclusions.
